title: Sound system and exhaust note
summary: Feedback on sound centers on strong praise for the speaker and sound system quality, while criticism focuses on a muted or artificial exhaust note and some disappointing audio performance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the speakers and sound system as excellent, amazing, and a strong part of the driving experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the exhaust and cabin sound as terrible, muted, fake, or disappointing, with some specifically unhappy with Harman Kardon audio quality.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention expectations for a better or more natural exhaust sound and some speaker-related trim context, but the sampled fragments do not always state a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about the overall direction of opinion within this topic.
This topic combines two related but distinct subjects—audio speakers/sound system and exhaust/engine sound—so not every fragment reflects the same aspect.
The examples are limited and stratified rather than representative, so they should not be treated as frequency estimates for all reviews.
